title: Transition Fills for Newly Enrolled Pharmacy Benefit Members
content:
**Coverage policy — Pharmacy Benefit.** This policy concerns a new member who was already taking a drug that is not on the PrairieRx formulary.

### Clause in force

**A second transition fill for the same drug is never paid.** Once a transition fill of a drug has been paid on the member's coverage, no further transition fill of that same drug pays.

### Retired clause

The following clause is **no longer in force**: *"A new member already taking a non-formulary drug receives one transition fill of up to the plan's transition fill days supply within the plan's transition window days after the pharmacy coverage effective date, recorded as a transition fill, while an exception is requested."* The transition fill is now governed by the current transition fill basis of the Pharmacy Benefit. The plan figures for the transition window days and the transition fill days supply remain the plan's figures.

### Point of judgement

*A transition fill of a drug is already on the member's claims, and the same drug is presented again for a transition fill.* It is not paid: a second transition fill for the same drug is never paid. A transition fill of a different drug is not barred by this clause.

superseded_clauses: A new member already taking a non-formulary drug receives one transition fill of up to transition_fill_days_supply within transition_fill_window_days after the rx coverage effective_date, recorded with fill_type transition_fill, while an exception is requested.
